mentions.name: Digital Loyalty Cards for Cafés
mentions.description: Digital loyalty card service for cafés that serves as an electronic version of paper stamp cards. Customers add loyalty passes directly to Apple and Google wallets with no app install or customer signup required. Built with Ruby on Rails and currently free while the author gathers feedback.
mentions.problem: Paper stamp loyalty cards are outdated, and existing digital loyalty solutions require customers to install apps or sign up.
mentions.audience: Café owners looking to run customer loyalty programs.
mentions.source_excerpt: It provides digital loyalty cards for cafés (think of an electronic version of paper stamp cards). However with zero apps or customer signup, instead loyalty passes go straight into Apple and Google wallets.

evidence.value: It provides digital loyalty cards for cafés (think of an electronic version of paper stamp cards). However with zero apps or customer signup, instead loyalty passes go straight into Apple and Google wallets.
